alias_algorithm: Generate SHA-256-derived opaque tokens from root_seed and counter, sort original IDs and tokens, then zip them to preserve lexical rank

analysis_contract.dealiasing: Replace declared alias tokens with original trajectory IDs before every set/hash comparison.
analysis_contract.evidence_context_hash: SHA-256 of compact ASCII JSON with sorted object keys over the ordered valid spans; each span stores de-aliased trajectory_id, inclusive indices, and exact selected public state objects in source order.
analysis_contract.failure_coding: Retain missing, malformed, timeout, exhausted-retry, empty-prose, empty-span and invalid-span outcomes. For distance calculations, no valid output contributes empty prose/sets; completion and retry states remain separate outcomes. Partial valid outputs are retained without post hoc exclusion.
analysis_contract.prose_distance: Character-level Levenshtein distance on normalized prose divided by max character length; define empty versus empty as 0.
analysis_contract.prose_normalization: Unicode NFKC; normalize CRLF/CR to LF; strip; collapse every Unicode whitespace run to one ASCII space.
analysis_contract.selected_state_set: Expand each valid inclusive span to unique (trajectory_id,state_index) pairs after de-aliasing.
analysis_contract.selected_trajectory_set: Unique de-aliased trajectory IDs appearing in valid spans.
analysis_contract.set_distance: Jaccard distance 1-|intersection|/|union|; define empty versus empty as 0.

randomization_algorithm: SHA-256 rank v1: rank each indexed item by SHA256(root_seed|purpose|index|value), breaking a digest tie by original index
unreleased_gates: exact Codex CLI no-bypass local signing-trust gate
